content:
maya: Weekly check-in for HelixAI dedicated pool (ded-helix-1) — quick snapshot and asks. Pls react with :thumbsup: if OK or flag any blockers.

maya: 7-day highlights:
- GPU hours: 312h (↑18% week-over-week)
- Peak pool saturation: 83% (3 days at 95% 09:00–12:00 UTC)
- Avg queue depth: 14 requests (p99 spike 62)
- p95 response latency: 210ms (inference path)
- Error rate: 0.9% (was 0.2% last week) — mostly OOM/kv-cache misses
- Spend (billing): $12,420 (est. monthly run-rate $53k)

maya: Notable: onboarding traffic from their AB test added a burst on Tue that filled the queue for ~45m. They also rolled a new hf:model-quantized variant which reduced token cost but introduced occasional OOMs.

samir: digging into OOMs now. initial hypothesis: the quantized variant increases KV working set due to different block size. seeing log snippets like:
```
inference: worker-7 OOM at step 3421, model=hf-quant-v2, mem=14.8GB
cache: kv_eviction triggered, queue_depth=27
```
samir: I can throttle concurrent sessions for that model to protect the pool. will push a temporary limit to 6 concurrent for hf-quant-v2 on ded-helix-1.

devon: planning a capacity tweak: enable auto-burst on ded-helix-1 for business hours to absorb transient peaks. proposed config:
```
{ "pool":"ded-helix-1", "auto_burst":true, "burst_max_gpus":2, "burst_window_min":30 }
```
devon: this will add up to 2 GPUs for 30m windows when saturation >90%. any objections?

leo: finance note — Helix has committed to a Q2 reserved commitment but this level of overage will push them into top-tier billing. flagging for potential renewal conversation if we don't stabilize errors/latency.

anya: enablement update: onboarding docs updated with recommended concurrency and example client-side retry backoff. scheduled a 30-min runbook review with Helix on Thu 16:00 UTC. I'll include devs and Samir.

ops-bot: Alert: ded-helix-1 autoscaler triggered 2026-03-10T09:11:02Z — added 1 GPU. Current pool size 10/10 -> 11.

samir: quick mitigation done: limited hf-quant-v2 concurrency and enabled smaller kv cache chunking flag. monitoring for 2h.

maya: action items:
- samir: validate OOM rate drop and share logs (ETA 2h)
- devon: schedule auto-burst during business hours (ETA end of day)
- anya: runbook call Thu 16:00 UTC (invite sent)
- leo: prepare renewal playbook note if burst persists (FYI)

maya: if we hit >90% saturation again during business hours, we should consider a short canary for model fallback to hf-quant-v1 (less memory) and inform Helix product. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

samir: agree, canary makes sense. I'll prep a canary image and a traffic-split policy 90/10 fallback.

leo: good plan. also, let's surface potential monthly spend delta to CSM exec before Thu call.

maya: thanks team. will follow up with a concise readout after Samir and Devon confirm mitigations. :pray:
